ideas.what: Canonical coarsest stratification ('partition privilégiée') of a tame map, constructed by induction on the dimension of the base.
ideas.modern_name: Canonical (minimal) Whitney/Thom stratification of a map; coarsest definable stratification in o-minimal geometry
ideas.usually_credited_to: Whitney, Thom, Mather (stratified maps); Teissier (canonical Whitney stratification); o-minimal versions by van den Dries, Loi and others
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5-6 (tame topology, canonical stratifications, 'dévissage' of stratified structures), in programmatic form only

ideas.what: Strengthening the induction: work with spaces endowed with a finite family of closed subspaces, stable under finite intersection, so that the frontiers of strata can be imposed.
ideas.modern_name: Stratifications compatible with (adapted to) a given finite family of subsets
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard in stratification theory (Whitney, Łojasiewicz, Hironaka)
